{"id":1987982994,"question_id":4292,"lang":"cpp","lang_name":"C++","time":"2 months, 3 weeks","timestamp":1777138664,"status":10,"status_display":"Accepted","runtime":"0 ms","url":"/submissions/detail/1987982994/","is_pending":"Not Pending","title":"Compare Sums of Bitonic Parts","memory":"125.5 MB","code":"class Solution {\npublic:\n    using ll = long long;\n    int compareBitonicSums(vector<int>& nums) {\n        int n = nums.size();\n        int peak = -1;\n        ll sum_left = 0;\n        ll sum_right = 0;\n\n        for(int i = 0 ; i<n ; i++)\n        {\n            if(i-1 >= 0 and i+1 < n and (nums[i] > nums[i-1] and nums[i] > nums[i+1]))\n            {\n                peak = i;\n                break;\n            }\n        }\n        \n        for(int i = 0 ; i<=peak ; i++) sum_left += nums[i];\n        for(int i = peak ; i<n ; i++) sum_right += nums[i];\n\n        if(sum_left > sum_right) return 0;\n        if(sum_right > sum_left) return 1;\n        return -1;\n    }\n};","compare_result":"","title_slug":"compare-sums-of-bitonic-parts","has_notes":false,"flag_type":1,"frontend_id":1940}
